title: 指定 Tag 处理方式

standard.summary: drop_all 全部移除，random_n 仅在命中 tag
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.random_n: 命中里随机扔 N 个。

standard_en.summary: drop_all removes them all; random_n only acts on tags that match.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.random_n: Throws away N at random from the matches.

advanced.principle: drop_all 全部移除，random_n 仅在命中 tag 中随机丢弃 N 个

advanced_en.principle: drop_all removes all matches; random_n randomly drops N of the matched tags.
